name: Foundation & Booking Core
goal: A guest can book an available appointment end-to-end.

issues.title: Project scaffolding (frontend + backend + CI)
acceptance: Frontend and backend packages build and run.
CI workflow runs lint, typecheck, and tests on PR.

issues.title: Database schema + migrations (core entities)
acceptance: Migrations create User, Service, Category, Staff, Appointment, etc.
Seed script populates sample services and staff.

issues.title: Auth: register, login, JWT, password reset
acceptance: Register and login return JWT + refresh token.
Password reset via email works.
Passwords hashed with argon2/bcrypt.

issues.title: Service catalog API (list/detail/filter)
acceptance: GET /api/services lists and filters by category/price/duration.
GET /api/services/:id returns detail.

issues.title: Service catalog UI (browse + filter)
acceptance: Services grouped by category.
Filter by category, price, duration.

issues.title: Staff working hours + time-off model & API
acceptance: Staff set weekly working hours and breaks.
One-off time off blocks slots.

issues.title: Availability engine (slot computation)
acceptance: Returns only free slots.
Respects staff hours, time off, duration, and buffer.
Unit tests cover overlap, buffer, boundary cases.

issues.title: Booking API (create/reschedule/cancel, no double-book)
acceptance: Concurrent booking of same slot: exactly one success, other gets 409.
Reschedule and cancel respect policy window.
Concurrency test included.

issues.title: Booking flow UI (select -> slot -> confirm)
acceptance: Guest can book without account.
Slot picker shows only available times.
Confirmation screen after booking.

issues.title: Confirmation email on booking
acceptance: Booking sends confirmation email.
Email includes service, staff, date/time, cancel link.
